name: truex-membrane
description: Dynamic JavaScript proxy creation with isolated context-based interception

scripts.release: npm test && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:full: vitest run && pnpm doctor:ecosystem && pnpm doctor:mailbox && pnpm doctor:finalization
scripts.doctor:ecosystem: TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 tsx scripts/truex.ts doctor prove ecosystem
scripts.doctor:mailbox: TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 tsx scripts/truex.ts doctor prove mailbox
scripts.doctor:finalization: TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 tsx scripts/truex.ts doctor prove finalization
scripts.finalization:12h: pnpm doctor:ecosystem && pnpm doctor:mailbox && pnpm doctor:finalization && pnpm observatory
